title: High-Flow Payment Percentage by Coverage Class — Home Oxygen Therapy Equipment Months
content:
# High-Flow Payment Percentage by Coverage Class — Home Oxygen Therapy

**Schedule rule.** For a Home Oxygen Therapy equipment month paid in full by the coverage, the amount is multiplied by:

- **93 percent** when the prescribed flow on the oxygen record is above the class's high-flow threshold (**4 LPM** for every class) and the coverage named on the oxygen record is Commercial PPO or Commercial HMO;
- **87 percent** when that flow is above that threshold and the coverage is Medicaid Fee-for-Service;
- **100 percent** otherwise.

The coverage class is read from the patient's Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility records for the coverage the oxygen record names. The multiplication acts on the amount as it stands, without rounding.

## Truth table

| Prescribed flow above 4 LPM | Coverage class named on the oxygen record | Percentage |
|---|---|---|
| yes | Commercial PPO or Commercial HMO | 93 |
| yes | Medicaid Fee-for-Service | 87 |
| yes | any other class (Original Medicare Part B, Medicare Supplement Plan G, Medicare Advantage PPO, Medicare Advantage HMO and any further class) | 100 |
| no (4 LPM or less) | any | 100 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical amount of 200.00)

| Flow | Coverage class | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| 5 LPM | Commercial HMO | 200.00 multiplied by 93 percent: 186.00 |
| 5 LPM | Medicaid Fee-for-Service | 200.00 multiplied by 87 percent: 174.00 |
| 4 LPM | Commercial PPO | 200.00 |
| 5 LPM | Medicare Advantage PPO | 200.00 |
